# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Attached provenance and confidence metadata (ParamMeta entries) to high-value parameters across four TOML data files covering nitrogen kinetics, carbonate chemistry, shrimp biology, and source-water profiles. Created a developer-facing summary doc (docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md) that classifies all priority parameters by confidence tier (literature/expert/heuristic/placeholder) so future tuning and validation work can focus on the weakest assumptions first. Updated two tests in presets.rs whose assertions were invalidated by the newly-populated param_meta in default.toml.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Added 16 param_meta entries to crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml covering AOB/NOB/comammox Ks values, decomposer Ks, stoichiometric constants (o2_per_mg_n_nitrified, alkalinity_meq_per_mg_n_nitrified), plant growth rate maxima, and algae/periphyton growth rate maxima. Each entry includes unit, source citation, confidence level, valid_range, and notes. Added TODO comment for denitrification parameters that cannot receive param_meta until ProcessParamsPreset is extended.
2. [Completed] Added 13 param_meta entries to crates/tank_data/data/shrimp/neocaridina_davidi.toml covering reproduction temperature curve (high_temp_repro_penalty_start_c, high_temp_repro_penalty_full_c, low_temp_repro_ramp_width_c), molt mineral thresholds (ca_min_mg_per_l, mg_min_mg_per_l, molt_stress_mineral_*_weight), chloride_protection_factor, body stoichiometric constants, and toxicant reproduction thresholds (TAN, NO2).
3. [Completed] Added 6 param_meta entries to crates/tank_data/data/source_water/hard_shrimp.toml for carbonate chemistry (dic_mg_c_per_l, alkalinity_meq_per_l, bicarbonate_mg_per_l) and mineral parameters (calcium, magnesium, chloride) relevant to both carbonate equilibrium and shrimp molt/nitrite protection.
4. [Completed] Added 3 param_meta entries to crates/tank_data/data/source_water/moderate.toml for representative carbonate chemistry (dic_mg_c_per_l, alkalinity_meq_per_l, chloride_mg_per_l) as a second annotated source-water example.
5. [Completed] Created docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md — developer-facing summary organizing all annotated parameters by confidence tier, identifying strong anchors vs provisional approximations, listing the denitrification TODO gap, and documenting which parameter families remain unannotated for future beads.
6. [Completed] Updated two tests in crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs: test_backward_compatible_loading (now asserts param_meta is non-empty for shipped default.toml) and test_process_preset_format_param_without_meta_shows_raw_value (switched to a parameter without metadata to preserve test intent).
7. [Completed] Ran full cargo test (all crates, all tests pass), cargo clippy (clean), verified all shipped presets load through the G1 schema with no diagnostics via the shipped_param_meta_loaders_return_no_diagnostics test.

## Validation Evidence

- cargo test --package tank_data: 33/33 tests pass including shipped_param_meta_loaders_return_no_diagnostics (verifies all enriched files load through G1 schema without special-case hacks)
- cargo test (full workspace): all tests pass across tank_core (97), tank_data (33), tank_scenarios (5), tank_api (3), tank_harness (41+), and all integration/e2e tests
- cargo clippy: clean, no warnings
- test_backward_compatible_loading confirms enriched default.toml validates successfully with param_meta present
- test_unknown_param_meta_keys_are_rejected still passes, confirming all added param_meta keys are recognized by the preset validation layer
- Process default.toml carries 16 param_meta entries across nitrogen kinetics (AOB/NOB/comammox/decomposer Ks), stoichiometric constants, and plant/algae growth maxima
- Shrimp preset carries 13 param_meta entries across reproduction, molt, toxicology, and stoichiometry tracks
- Two source-water presets (hard_shrimp, moderate) carry carbonate chemistry and mineral param_meta entries
- docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md provides developer-facing summary distinguishing literature/expert/heuristic/placeholder confidence tiers

## Outstanding Risks

- Denitrification parameters (5 params) are present in default.toml but not carried by ProcessParamsPreset, so they cannot receive formal param_meta entries. A TODO is documented in the TOML and in PROVENANCE_STATUS.md. The preset struct must be extended before these params can participate in range validation.
- Carbonate equilibrium constants (pKa1, pKa2, K_H) are computed in the carbonate solver code, not stored as preset parameters. They cannot receive param_meta through the current TOML-based mechanism. Their provenance is documented in PROVENANCE_STATUS.md but formal annotation requires a different approach (code comments or a separate constants registry).
- soft_acidic.toml and ro_like.toml source-water presets remain unannotated. Lower priority since they represent extreme cases less likely to be cited as defaults.
- Substrate and plant presets remain unannotated. Their parameters are less load-bearing for scientific claims but should be addressed in a follow-up bead.
- Literature citations in param_meta source fields are author-year shorthand, not full bibliographic entries. A proper references document may be needed for formal scientific claims.
